info.name: Profily API
info.description:
Portfolio builder API — GitHub OAuth, repo sync, CRUD for experience/education/social links.

## Authentication
All endpoints except Auth (login/callback) and Health require a session cookie.

1. Open `GET /api/auth/github` in browser
2. Complete GitHub OAuth
3. Copy the `session` cookie value from browser DevTools
4. Set the `session_id` collection variable

## Error Responses
All errors follow RFC 7807 Problem Details format.

variable.description: Session UUID from browser cookie after GitHub OAuth login

request.description: Lightweight liveness check. Returns 200 if the API is running. No authentication required.

item.name: Auth
item.description:
GitHub OAuth login flow and session management.

Flow:
1. `GET /api/auth/github` → redirects to GitHub
2. User authorizes → GitHub redirects to `/api/auth/callback`
3. Callback creates user + session, sets `session` cookie
4. All subsequent requests use the cookie automatically

request.description:
Redirects to GitHub OAuth authorization page.

**Open this in a browser** — Postman can't complete the OAuth flow.

Scopes requested: `read:user`, `user:email`, `repo`

After authorization, GitHub redirects to `/api/auth/callback` which:
- Creates or updates the user
- Encrypts and stores the GitHub token
- Creates a DB session
- Sets an HttpOnly `session` cookie
- Redirects to the frontend dashboard

Called by GitHub after user authorizes. **Do not call manually** — this is part of the OAuth redirect flow.

Exchanges the code for a GitHub access token, upserts the user, creates a session, and redirects to the frontend.

Returns the authenticated user's profile.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "username": "m7mdraafat",
  "displayName": "Mohamed Raafat",
  "avatarUrl": "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/...",
  "bio": "...",
  "location": "Egypt",
  "company": "Microsoft",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "gitHubUrl": "https://github.com/m7mdraafat",
  "reposCount": 27,
  "followersCount": 71,
  "contributionsThisYear": 0,
  "plan": "free",
  "planExpiresAt": null,
  "lastSyncedAt": "2026-03-27T...",
  "createdAt": "2026-03-27T..."
}
```
Deletes the session from the database and clears the session cookie. Returns 200 OK.

item.name: Projects
item.description: GitHub repository management. Repos are synced from GitHub and stored locally. Users can enable up to 10 repos for their portfolio.

request.description:
Fetches all repos from GitHub API and upserts them into the database.

- New repos are inserted
- Existing repos are updated (stars, description, topics, etc.)
- Repos deleted on GitHub are NOT removed (preserves custom descriptions)
- Updates `user.reposCount` and `user.lastSyncedAt`

Auto-triggered on first login. Manual re-sync via this endpoint.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "newRepos": 3,
  "updatedRepos": 24,
  "totalRepos": 27
}
```

Lists the user's GitHub repos with pagination.

Sorted by: enabled first → display order → stars descending.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "name": "VideStore.API",
      "description": "Full-stack e-commerce API",
      "customDescription": null,
      "language": "C#",
      "topics": ["dotnet", "api"],
      "stars": 1,
      "forks": 0,
      "isFork": false,
      "htmlUrl": "https://github.com/...",
      "homepageUrl": null,
      "isEnabled": true,
      "displayOrder": 0,
      "lastPushedAt": "2026-03-20T..."
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "totalCount": 27,
    "totalPages": 2
  }
}
```

Toggle enable/disable, set display order, or add a custom description.

**All fields are optional** (PATCH semantics). Only sent fields are updated.

**Constraints:**
- Maximum 10 projects can be enabled. Enabling an 11th returns `409 Conflict`.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "isEnabled": true,         // optional
  "displayOrder": 0,         // optional
  "customDescription": "..." // optional
}
```

item.name: Users
item.description: User profile management. Personal info is editable; GitHub-synced fields (username, avatar) are updated on login.

body.raw:
{
  "displayName": "Mohamed Raafat",
  "bio": "Backend engineer passionate about clean architecture",
  "location": "Cairo, Egypt",
  "company": "Microsoft",
  "email": "m7mdraafat2003@gmail.com"
}

request.description:
Update the current user's personal info.

**All fields are optional** (PATCH semantics). Only sent fields are updated.

**Validation:**
- `displayName`: max 200 chars
- `bio`: max 2000 chars
- `location`: max 200 chars
- `company`: max 200 chars
- `email`: max 300 chars, must be valid email format

**Returns:** Full user profile (same as GET /api/auth/me)

item.name: Experiences
item.description: Work experience entries. Manual CRUD. Ordered by `displayOrder`.

request.description:
Returns all experiences for the current user, ordered by `displayOrder`.

**Response:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": "uuid",
    "title": "Software Engineer",
    "company": "Microsoft",
    "startDate": "2025-06-01",
    "endDate": null,
    "isCurrent": true,
    "description": "Building scalable systems...",
    "displayOrder": 0
  }
]
```

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Software Engineer Intern",
  "company": "Microsoft",
  "startDate": "2025-06-01",
  "endDate": null,
  "isCurrent": true,
  "description": "Building scalable backend systems with .NET and Azure.",
  "displayOrder": 0
}

request.description:
Creates a new work experience entry.

**Validation:**
- `title`: required, max 200 chars
- `company`: required, max 200 chars
- `startDate`: required, must not be in the future
- `endDate`: optional, must be after `startDate` if provided
- `description`: optional, max 2000 chars

**Returns:** 201 Created with the new experience.

**Auto-saves** `experience_id` collection variable for use in update/delete.

Partially update an experience. Only sent fields are changed.

**Returns:** 200 OK with the updated experience.
**404:** If the experience doesn't exist or belongs to another user.

Deletes an experience entry.

**Returns:** 204 No Content.
**404:** If the experience doesn't exist or belongs to another user.

item.name: Social Links
item.description:
Social media links. One link per platform per user (e.g., one LinkedIn, one Twitter).

Platform examples: `github`, `linkedin`, `twitter`, `leetcode`, `facebook`, `medium`, `kaggle`.

GitHub link is auto-created on first sync.

request.description:
Returns all social links for the current user, ordered by `displayOrder`.

**Response:**
```json
[
  {
    "id": "uuid",
    "platform": "github",
    "url": "https://github.com/m7mdraafat",
    "iconFilename": "github.svg",
    "displayOrder": 0
  },
  {
    "id": "uuid",
    "platform": "linkedin",
    "url": "https://linkedin.com/in/m7mdraafat",
    "iconFilename": "linkedin.svg",
    "displayOrder": 1
  }
]
```

Creates a new social link.

**Validation:**
- `platform`: required, max 50 chars
- `url`: required, max 500 chars, must be a valid absolute URL
- `iconFilename`: optional, max 100 chars

**Constraints:**
- One link per platform. Adding a second `linkedin` returns `409 Conflict`.

**Returns:** 201 Created.
**Auto-saves** `social_link_id` collection variable.

Partially update a social link. Platform cannot be changed (delete and recreate instead).

**Returns:** 200 OK.
**404:** If not found or belongs to another user.

Deletes a social link.

**Returns:** 204 No Content.
**404:** If not found or belongs to another user.
